title: Version 17.14.21
body_markdown:
*Released November 19th, 2025*

| Top bug fixes | From the community |
| --- | --- |
| Fix LINK : fatal error LNK1000 when rebuilding project with incremental linking enabled. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/problems-with-Visual-Stdio-2022-171415/10970302) |
| Fixed an incorrect codegen issue with ternary expressions involving expressions with arrays of different types. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/C:-Array-reference-is-incorrectly-calc/10972001) |
| ASAN reorders validation calls leading to false negatives | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/ASAN-reorders-validation-calls-leading-t/10885005) |
| Sanitizer Coverage Blocklist Broken | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Sanitizer-Coverage-Blocklist-Broken/10959808) |
| C4319 not emitted when compiling C code | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/C4319-not-emitted-when-compiling-C-code/10978009) |
| C++/CLI - inline namespace does not work | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/CCLI---inline-namespace-does-not-work/10978397) |
| Embedded and IoT tools component is deprecated in the Visual Studio Installer. |  |
| Mobile development with C++ workload, including the C++ Android and C++ iOS development tool components are deprecated in the Visual Studio Installer. |  |
| Fixed an issue when installing Visual Studio 2026 alongside Visual Studio 2022, where Visual Studio 2022 would incorrectly enable package pruning for all frameworks. This may result in unexpected NU1510 warnings when building from Visual Studio 2022. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Installing-VS2026-broke-my-VS2022-instal/10998270) |
| "Connect To Feed" popup causes Visual Studio to be unable to delete anything until restart | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Connect-To-Feed-popup-causes-Visual-St/10944733) |
| Visual Studio 2022 remote debug auto connect issue | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Visual-Studio-2022-remote-debug-auto-con/10927168) |
| Performance Profiler does not load symbols correctly for unmanaged code in C++/CLI | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Performance-Profiler-does-not-load-symbo/10977159) |
